Ship specs, christening, terminal, port docks, consulate numbers, and gratuity rate are INHERITED from the v0.1.8 sidecar (verified 2026-07-06 against the primary sources recorded there) — same ship, same ports; inheritance is recorded per-claim below rather than silently copied, per the copy-propagation rule. Newly verified this session: the Dec 5 2026 sailing itself (date, departure port, port order) and the December weather normals (computed, not recalled).
verified_by: syl (claude-code remote session, operator-directed family pack build)
verification_session: Sailing verified 2026-08-20 via two independent aggregators: web search results for 'MSC World America December 5 2026' (cruisetimetables/cruiseweb/cruisesonly summary: Sat Dec 5 2026 depart Miami ~4:30 PM; Roatan Dec 7 9a-6p; Costa Maya Dec 8 8a-5p; Cozumel Dec 9 9a-7p; Ocean Cay Dec 11 7a-6p; return Dec 12 7a) and icruise.com December-2026 itinerary page fetched in-session (Dec 5 2026, 7-night, Miami, ports Miami-Roatan-Costa Maya-Cozumel-Ocean Cay-Miami; also lists the 14-night B2B extension). Port-call TIMES rest on the aggregator summary only (single-source) — the pack therefore phrases every time as 'published ~X, verify in the MSC for Me app'. PORT ORDER and DATE are two-source. Departure port is Miami (PortMiami MSC terminal), not Port Everglades — both sources agree.

december_weather_normals.method: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive API, daily temperature_2m_max/min and precipitation_sum at each port's coordinates, Dec 5-12 window, years 2020-2024 (40 days per port), simple mean; wet-day = precipitation_sum > 1.0 mm. Computed in-session 2026-08-20; raw responses retained in session scratchpad.
december_weather_normals.notes: Sea-day values in pack/PWA (79/73 southbound, 77/72 northbound) are interpolations from adjacent-port normals and are labeled as estimates in both artifacts. The Roatan 75% wet-day figure drives the pack's rainy-season honesty note. 'Northers'/cold-front language is standard Gulf winter climatology, framed qualitatively ('can bring'), no frequency claimed.

roatan_dock.claim: MSC World America docks at the Port of Roatan at Coxen Hole (used by MSC/RCL/NCL/Virgin), NOT Mahogany Bay.
roatan_dock.disposition: CORRECTION 2026-07-06: the pack had the Roatan port REVERSED — it named Mahogany Bay as 'MSC and Royal Caribbean's purpose-built pier'. Mahogany Bay (rebranded Isla Tropicale) is Carnival Corporation's exclusive facility (Carnival/Princess); MSC uses Coxen Hole. The whole Roatan section (arrival, 'free walkable' bullets incl. the Mahogany-Bay-only 'Magical Flying Beach Chair' lift, and the West Bay taxi distance) was rewritten for Coxen Hole. Same error found independently in the Symphony pack (RCL).
